notes.title: Top Hat Showcase and 0.4 for everyone - YES for the demo too!
notes.content:
Citizens, the time has come!

We're happy to announce that as part of the Top Hat Studios showcase, we have debuted a brand new trailer in order to highlight all the mechanics in SteamDolls. 

You can view the new trailer below:

[previewyoutube=-vyXzXTMATo;full][/previewyoutube]

BUT ALSO, FINALLY, Version 0.4 is now officially live for everyone! 🔥
INCLUDING THE DEMO! 🔥

Yes — even the demo now runs on Version 0.4, letting new players experience just how far we’ve come.

After a decent run on the Beta Branch and valuable feedback from those brave enough to test it early, we've ironed out the kinks, polished the edges, and made key improvements based on what you experienced.

🛠️ Patch Notes – Steamdolls 0.4 🛠️
Finalized and deployed after Beta testing

Save Data Overhaul
The save system has been fully reworked to eliminate stutters on lower-end machines — including the Steam Deck. Smoother saves, smoother runs.

Energy Recharge Feedback
Enhanced animations give a better feel and more responsive energy recharge. Small detail, big impact.

Mob Balancing & Enemy Death Improvements

Enemy health and speed have been fine-tuned for a fair but challenging combat experience.

Enemies now die instantly (no more floaty delays) and won't try to attack while dying.

Some placements have been adjusted based on your feedback to reduce frustrating chokepoints.

Dash Attack Simplification
We’ve streamlined the dash attack mechanics for smoother, more intuitive execution. It just feels right now.

Improved Map Navigation

You can now move the map more freely.

Marker tracking system added.

Markers now auto-remove after solving puzzles or opening new paths, preventing clutter.

Level Design Adjustments
Several zones were tweaked to better support stealthy players and reward thoughtful approaches.

Ladders (Yes, finally!)
We’ve fixed and refined ladder behavior after extensive testing. Up you go — the right way.

Combat Feel Enhancements

Better anticipation for Whisper’s attacks.

Freeze frames on hit make combat snappier and more brutal.

White flash when humanoid enemies die = instant feedback.

Damage colliders and attack animations now sync perfectly.

Blade particles and sound effects are retimed to feel cleaner and sharper.

Whisper’s Animator Controller Rework
We’ve reworked Whisper’s entire animation controller for smoother, more fluid movement.
Includes a brand-new jump animation that finally gives his motion the punch it deserves.

⚠️ Some minor animation bugs may still lurk — let us know if you spot any oddities.

🔧 Bug Fixes & Polish
Too many small fixes to list, but the whole experience should feel tighter and more refined now.

What’s Next?
With 0.4 solidifying the core systems, we’re shifting gears toward narrative expansion — expect new zones, deeper lore, and the next pieces of the story puzzle.

We're also happy to announce that a 0.5 update will be coming soon.

⚙️ Incoming in Version 0.5 – Teaser Breakdown
“What breaks the mind is not the cage. It’s knowing someone is watching.”

🎬 New Hand-Drawn Cutscene
You wanted it, we love it — and it’s back.
A brand-new animated cutscene will drop with 0.5, continuing Whisper’s descent and adding another layer to the mythos. Expect stunning, gritty hand-drawn frames that crackle with tension.
(This one's personal.)

🧱 New Biome: The Prison Asylum
A self-contained story biome soaked in shadows and regrets.
Explore the Prison Asylum — a place where the mad, the augmented, and the forgotten are locked away... often for knowing too much.

Twisted architecture, corrupted surveillance systems.

Cells filled with incomplete whispers of the past.

Echoes of experiments and rebellions long buried.

🧟‍♂️ New Enemies
Brutal new foes unique to the Prison Asylum.

Twisted ex-soldiers, broken cyborg patients, and eyes that never blink.

Expect tighter, more oppressive encounters that test your reflexes and your paranoia.

💬 Badass Dialogue: Whisper x Gabriel x ???
The Whisper and Gabriel trade barbs, threats, and philosophical venom.

Their ideological clash burns brighter than ever.

And then there’s... the Warden.
A new character shrouded in mystery — a wannabe star who think he is in a game show.
No one knows who he answer to.
Some say he never blink. Some say he is not real.
All we know is: he is watching.

🧪 Experimental Mechanics (Top Secret)
Multiple experimental gameplay tests will be hidden inside 0.5.
Preparing the game for the next updates coming after it.


0.5 is not just an update — it’s a descent.
Get ready to dig into the cracks of the city’s foundation — and maybe your own.

Try the demo again. Feel the difference.
This isn’t a patch — it’s a statement.

👁️ The Eye will not like what you’re about to discover.
But we will.

notes.title: Steamdolls 0.4 Beta Available Now!
notes.content:
Citizens, the time has come!

Version 0.4 is now live on the Beta Branch! 

Anyone who wishes to test it can do so by opting into the beta branch using the password: 

[b]gimmethebeta[/b]

This is your chance to experience the latest refinements before they roll out to everyone. After a few days of testing and feedback, Version 0.4 will be pushed to the general branch!

[b]🛠️ Patch Notes – Steamdolls 0.4 🛠️[/b]

[b]Save Data Overhaul[/b] 

Reworked the save data system to eliminate stutters on lower-end machines, including the Steam Deck.

[b]Energy Recharge Feedback[/b] 

New animations enhance the feel and responsiveness of energy recharging.

[b]Mob Balancing & Enemy Death Improvements[/b]

Enemy health and speed have been fine-tuned to create a challenging but fair combat experience.

Enemy deaths feel much better! They now die instantly instead of having a floaty delay and will no longer try to initiate an attack while dying.

Some enemy placements have been adjusted to reduce overly punishing encounters.

[b]Dash Attack Simplification[/b] 

Dash attack mechanics streamlined for smoother, more intuitive execution.

[b]Improved Map Navigation[/b]

More directions to move the map and a manager to track markers, making exploration clearer and navigation easier.

Markers now properly erase when you complete a task or remove an obstacle using your abilities, preventing unnecessary clutter.

[b]Level Design Adjustments[/b]

A couple of zones have been reworked to better reward stealthy approaches and encourage strategic gameplay.

[b]Ladders (Finally!) [/b]

Fixed and refined ladder mechanics after extensive testing.

[b]Combat Feel Enhancements [/b]

We've made key improvements to make every hit feel more impactful and satisfying:

Better anticipation on some of Whisper’s attacks.

Freeze frames on hit to emphasize impact—let us know if we need more because I honestly don’t know if there are enough.

White flash effect when humanoid enemies die for better feedback.

Retimed damage collider activation to sync better with attack animations.

Blade particles and sound effects have been retimed for a cleaner and more responsive feel.

[b]Whisper’s Animator Controller Rework[/b]

We are in the process of reworking the Whisper’s entire animator controller to enhance animations and fluidity.

Brand-new jump animation! Whisper now has an amazing new jump that makes movement feel smoother and more dynamic.

Since this is a major change, there may be some issues, so let us know if you run into anything unusual!

[b]🔧 Bug Fixes & Polishing[/b] 

Various tweaks, refinements, and small fixes to improve overall gameplay.

[b]How to Access the Beta Branch[/b]

Go to your Steam Library.

Right-click on Steamdolls and select 'Properties'.

Navigate to the 'Betas' tab.

Enter the password: 

[b]gimmethebeta[/b]

and select the beta branch.

Download the update and play!

Your feedback is invaluable! Help us fine-tune this build. 

Try it out, share your thoughts, and let’s make Steamdolls even better together.

[b]🚨 Once Version 0.4 moves to the general branch, we will also update the demo! 🚨[/b]

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

With 0.4 solidifying the core mechanics, our next focus is on expanding the story content. Stay tuned for new narrative developments, deeper world-building, and fresh challenges ahead!

[b]👁️ The Eye might be watching, but we’re listening. 👁️[/b]

[b]PS : Oops, the title screen still says 0.3—I forgot to update it! I'll fix it when 0.4 goes to the general branch. 😅[/b]

notes.title: Steamdolls Update: Get Ready for Version 0.4 – The Revolution is Almost Here!
notes.content:
Hello Citizens!

We know you've been waiting patiently, and we’re getting so close! We're thrilled to let you know that everything we've been working on is now ready, polished, and brimming with exciting new content. Our team has been hard at work, and soon you’ll get to dive into it all!

[b]Here is what we achieved:[/b]

[b]Save Data Overhaul:[/b] We've reworked the save data system to silence stutters on lower-end machines like the Steam Deck. The game should run smoother than ever, no matter where you play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]Energy Recharge Feedback:[/b] The updated energy recharge system is complete, featuring brand-new animations that bring the game’s flow and feel to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]Mob Balancing:[/b] Enemy health and speed have been fine-tuned, striking the perfect balance between challenge and fairness. Get ready for encounters that will keep you on your toes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]Dash Attack Simplification:[/b] The dash attack mechanics have been revamped for smoother, more intuitive action. Pulling off that perfect move will be easier and more satisfying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]Improved Map Navigation:[/b] With enhanced directions and a map manager to track icons, finding your way through the game has never been clearer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]Ladders (Yes, Really!):[/b] After countless experiments and iterations, we’ve finally nailed the ladder mechanics. Thank you for sticking with us—this eternal battle has been won! And also YES we have new animations for climbing up and down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

🛠️ Minor Corrections: We’ve squashed bugs, polished mechanics, and smoothed out rough edges to ensure the best possible experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/ad31d259f6b8c53ad0949b935f6bf96e3c0a47d3.png[/img]

[b]When is it available?[/b]

We’re currently giving our build a final polish, and we plan to unveil it right after Steamfest. We know everyone is busy enjoying all the amazing demos, so we’ll wait for the perfect moment to make our update shine.

When the next update drops, it will bring Steamdolls to Version 0.4, marking a major milestone! All core mechanics have been improved and perfected, setting a strong foundation for everything yet to come.

Stay tuned, keep the feedback coming, and get ready for a whole new level of Steamdolls madness!

Thank you for being an incredible part of this journey.

👁️ The Eye might be watching, but we’re listening. 👁️

notes.title: 🔥 Patch Notes – Version 0.3 is Here!
notes.content:
Whispers never rest, and neither do we. SteamDolls: Order of Chaos has just been updated to Version 0.3, bringing fresh fixes, improvements, and a new demo. Here’s what’s changed:


🔧 Fixes & Adjustments

    
Health orbs now properly drop after stealth kill animations—your silent work is finally rewarded.
   
Lowered speed and damage of Richard’s homing bullets (he’s still a menace, just less of one).
    
Turret can now break the destructible wall in Zone 3.
    
Corrected a layout issue in Zone 3.
    
Fixed an issue in Zone 2 where Focus wouldn’t turn off after a dialogue.


🔥 New Additions & Improvements

    
4K resolution is now available! The darkness has never looked sharper.
    
Fire has been added in the ruin scene… because what’s a ruin without fire?
    
Better recharge feedback on energy dispensers—know exactly when you’re juiced up.
    
Began work on refining the weapon wheel feedback—stay tuned.

⚠ Disclaimer: We’ve tried to get the map discovery system under control with this patch. Let’s see if it actually worked… keep an eye on it and report anything strange.

🎮 New Demo Available!

A fresh SteamDolls demo is now up, featuring all the fixes from today along with the major overhaul update. If you haven’t tried the game yet, now’s the perfect time to dive in.

SteamDolls continues to evolve. Keep whispering, keep slicing, and let us know what you think.

The Whisper is listening.

notes.title: Weapon Wheel, Stealth Kills Animations and More: The Whisper’s Latest Update
notes.content:
Hello Citizens,

SteamDolls: Order of Chaos has evolved. The major overhaul update is here and ready for you to download! We’ve been listening, tweaking, and sharpening the experience to make it deadlier, smoother, and even more immersive. Here's what's now available for you to download:

[*] New Weapon Wheel System – Switch between your tools of destruction seamlessly!

    Tap Y to swap instantly.
    Hold Y to bring up the weapon wheel with a slow-motion effect for tactical choices.
    Both classic swapping and the new wheel work perfectly together—your style, your rules.

[*] Stealth Kills Revamped – New brutal stealth kill animations added! Get up close, strike from the darkness, and watch your enemies fall in style. 

⚠️ Some of these animations might need tweaking, but rest assured, we’ll be fine-tuning them with your feedback.

[*] Stealth Tension Enhanced – Now, you hold the button to stay hidden. Feel the pressure as you wait for the perfect moment to strike.

[*] Focus Feels Just Right – Now also hold-to-use, because it just works better this way.

[*] Dash Attack Reworked – Press a direction + RB for a seamless, deadly lunge. No more accidents.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This update has been intense, and while we’ve worked hard to make these changes as smooth as possible, some things may have broken along the way. Stay vigilant and keep an eye out for any oddities. If you spot anything, don’t hesitate to report it. But rest assured—The Whisper will correct any issues quickly.

Additionally, the 4K resolution option will be added tomorrow, so get ready for an even sharper experience!

This is just the beginning—more refinements, polish, and chaos are coming your way. Keep spreading the word, leaving feedback, and carving your path through the madness.

The Whisper is watching.

Download the update now and let the madness unfold.

TOMORROW : 4K Resolution and DEMO Update!

notes.title: February 14 Update - Fixes & Updates
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for the support on the game so far! Here is today's changelog, which mainly addresses several smaller bugs and issues rolling over from our day 1 patch.
[list]
[*] Pause menu : description of the grenade no longer overlaps with the rotating Whisper anymore
[*] Big Elevator freeze fixed
[*] Total overhaul of the train/home/fast travel zone!
[*] Menus in the trains are now displaying the correct bindings for controller/keyboard
[*] Travel Menu is now translated
[*] image for metro 3 destination is now correct
[*] In the train base, highlights are now placed on the ground to show where the furniture spots are; there is also a new button to enter build mode - it made more sense to use the focus button to enter BUILD MODE. Try it!
[*] Lore terminal and Lore texts are much more readable. Some translations have been fixed. 
[*] Corrected some instances whre the music was not playing 
[/list]

[i]Special thanks to both Diegoama and Kirei Kobayashi in this update as well![/i]

Also, thank you again to everyone who has been playing the game and leaving feedback. Once again, if you have been playing and have been enjoying the game, be sure to leave a review! It helps us a lot.

See you again soon! The team is currently working on the first major content update.

notes.title: OUT NOW! + Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

STEAMDOLLS is officially in Early Access!! Have you picked up the game yet?

We have a day 1 hotfix out now, which has the following fixes;
[list]
[*] Dash is now working with keyboard/Dash rebinds now properly
[*] Rebinds now save properly
[*] Upgrades terminal is now working as intended/Correct amount of money for buying
[*] Major overhaul of Boss 3/Impossible to skip it now/New devastating attack
[*] Drones can't get stuck in a neverending death loop
[*] Money now insta-saves
[*] various other fixes/mechanic balancing
[/list]

If you find something very suspicious, please report it! As with the possibility of any update, it might have broken your game (although we don’t foresee this). Especially if you bought upgrades at the discount price not intended and you see any clear issues, you may want to restart your save.

We are also aware getting back up on the big elevator might get cause you to be frozen in place in some rare circumstances. We are aware and will fix it.

Once again, if you see any issues - please be sure to report! Otherwise, we hope you are enjoying the early access - please be sure to give us your thoughts on such. [b] If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review - it helps us tremendously! [/b]

Thank you very much for your support as always and see you soon!

notes.title: STEAMDOLLS EARLY ACCESS OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Hello Citizens,

Welcome to release day! That's right - [b]SteamDolls is OUT NOW in Early Access.[/b] You can view the latest trailer below:

[previewyoutube=TxYzTi78jNk;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, the game is $19.99 - the price will go up as we get closer to the 1.0 release.  The team has worked tremendously hard on the game. [b]We will be tracking ALL bug reports that come in as well as all feedback.[/b] We believe feedback to be incredibly vital to Early Access and want to ensure the game is perfect at 1.0.

You can join the game's Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/UqNRXvQ]https://discord.gg/UqNRXvQ[/url]

Also as a reminder, if you enjoy the game - [b]be sure to leave a review[/b]! It helps us substantially.

As mentioned in our last post, here is what to currently expect in Early Access:

[list]
[*] Roughly 5-7 hours of content, and substantial bonus content (about 50-60% of the overall game)
[*] 6 chapters of the story, each containing a large biome (interconnected to the main world), each capped off with one boss
[*] Completely and fully voiced content by our star-studded cast of David Hayter, Christopher Randolph, Jennifer Hale, and more
[/list]

And here is a small sampling of changes in game for those who have played prior versions: 

[list]
[*] Substantial fixes to combat + animation improvements - combat is now less "hack and slashy" and more diversified and integrated with the game's stealth system. There are now different combos and types of attacks, and more of an integration for secondary weapons.
[*] Enemy AI improvements and fixes, including enemy "detection" for stealth. Much smarter than before!
[*] Complete stealth system overhaul - detailed further in tutorial
[*] "Focus" Mode (the hacking mode) now gives additional information, such as hard to see traps, stealth detection alarms, and more
[*] State/Upgrade System, to spend hard-earned cash on and customize your gameplay style
[*] Collect lore, furniture, and other trophies in your whisper hideout 
[*] Substantial polish and design changes to level layouts, animations, and more
[*[ New introductory sequence(s) and lots of new cutscenes and gameplay sequences
[*] Redesigned side content and bonus routes in each biome
[/list]

Once again, we will note that our job is never done. We continue to make changes and fixes based on player feedback throughout Early Access - feedback is one of our #1 goals in Early Access and we are excited to see what everyone thinks of the game. Below are some screenshots highlighting various parts of our Early Access:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/4a2a7b26731d841b6fef8ed1e1d6ba9583ba9e64.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37688598/0fb7146ac75a71b46e63912fe27385716ff516f1.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy, and see you again soon! We will be regularly posting (likely on a monthly basis) detailing updates and other thoughts from our end.

notes.content:
Hello Citizens,

We come today with amazing news - perhaps best expressed through a very flashy, brand new trailer:

[previewyoutube=zuV_zkPcNpc;full][/previewyoutube]

That's right - we're launching next [b]Tuesday, February 11th, into Early Access![/b] We'll be launching at [b]1pm EST / 10am PST / 6pm UTC.[/b] All previous backers of the game will receive a steam key for early access as well. [b]Plus, an updated demo is out now![/b] This features lots of gameplay changes we collected from the NextFest based on player feedback. Here's a small sampling of changes:

[list]
[*] Substantial fixes to combat + animation improvements - combat is now less "hack and slashy" and more diversified and integrated with the game's stealth system. There are now different combos and types of attacks, and more of an integration for secondary weapons.
[*] Enemy AI improvements and fixes, including enemy "detection" for stealth. Much smarter than before!
[*] Complete stealth system overhaul - detailed further in tutorial
[*] "Focus" Mode (the hacking mode) now gives additional information, such as hard to see traps, stealth detection alarms, and more
[*] State/Upgrade System, to spend hard-earned cash on and customize your gameplay style
[*] Collect lore, furniture, and other trophies in your whisper hideout 
[*] Substantial polish and design changes to level layouts, animations, and more
[*[ New introductory sequence(s) and lots of new cutscenes and gameplay sequences
[*] Redesigned side content and bonus routes in each biome
[/list]

Here's what to expect from the Early Access release:

[list]
[*] Roughly 5-7 hours of content, and substantial bonus content (about 50-60% of the overall game)
[*] 6 chapters of the story, each containing a large biome (interconnected to the main world), each capped off with one boss
[*] Completely and fully voiced content by our star-studded cast of David Hayter, Christopher Randolph, Jennifer Hale, and more
[/list]

Note that our job is never done. We continue to make changes and fixes based on player feedback throughout Early Access - feedback is one of our #1 goals in Early Access and we are excited to see what everyone thinks of the game. Below are some screenshots of some of our many changes since you last saw us - see you next Tuesday!

notes.title: HUGE DEMO UPDATE + UPCOMING NEWS
notes.content:
Hello Citizens,

Based on feedback, we've been hard at working updating the demo. Player feedback is extremely important to us, and as we begin to head into Early Access in the near future, we wanted to ensure we had a polished project, and the demo should reflect that. Here are a list of changes implemented in the demo:

-[b]Totally revamped COMBAT SYSTEM[/b]
[i]Concept demo "Aggressive Whisper" is back and even got upgraded![/i]

We've overhauled the demo, and added lots of new moves and fluidity to The Whisper. Here are some new attacks added:
-Lunge attack
-Charge attack
-2 swift normal combos
-1 walking attack

-There is also a brand new comprehensive [b]STEALTH MODE[/b].
[i]Concept demo "Sneaking Whisper" is restored to his former glory![/i]
-STEALTH ON/OFF feature
-Walk animation added for sneaking
-Camera effects for stealth mode
-Enemies act according to your behavior, with different detections for ON/OFF.

-[b]New animations[/b] have been added the new move set and indicators for the player, giving a better snappier Whisper to play with.

-Shortened start sequence to get quickly into action. Tutorial has been changed.

-New [b]TITLE SCREEN[/b] with a brand[b] NEW FONT[/b] (still work in progress)

Here are some things which we are currently working on, to be added soon and to be expected in the upcoming Early Access:

[b]REPUTATION SYSTEM[/b]
A system allowing you to get crucial rewards by killing enemies or exploring the map.
[i]"Yes! it is basically XP!" "You will now have an increased incentive to fight!"[/i]

[b]MORE BALANCING[/b]
Balancing is in constant flux and we're expecting this to be redone, especially for bosses and standard enemies.

[b]BETTER ANIMATIONS FOR EVERY CHARACTERS[/b]
We are looking to improve most animations in the game to give a snappier experience. Currently we started this by reworking some animations for the whisper, including some reworks to [b]ladders, which are currently partially implemented[/b].

[b]BETTER MENUS[/b]
We are looking to redo the UI in game to be more polished and accessible.

notes.title: Demo Update + Upcoming Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello citizens,

Thank you all for your support so far in playing the demo. We greatly appreciate the feedback which we've received so far! We have already implemented some feedback, of which can be viewed in the changelog below:

[list]
[*] Added disclaimers for early build
[*] New animated title screen (Font is still a WIP)
[*] Fixed a bug in tutorial progression, stealth is now properly explained
[*] Added option to skip tutorial monologue
[*] Added improved stealth/sneak mechanic for combat, tweaked alarm mechanic
[/list]

The development team listening to feedback and is very keen on ensuring the game is the best experience for everyone. As such, currently, there are some of the things they are focused on fixing in the near future:

[list]
[*] Improved combat
[*] Improving animations
[*] Balancing
[*] Mechanical Changes
[*] Visual polish, including on menus & fonts
[/list]

As a reference, the team is planning for this title to go into Early Access rather than a full release. The entire development team is 2 people, and this is a very ambitious project. Needless to say, they are aware there is always room for improvement and doing their best to make the best quality project possible.  There will be more information on the Early Access release soon as well!
